title: Visual Instruction Tuning
layout_note: The pipeline is drawn as horizontal bands stacked bottom-to-top: the vision encoder and projection are two short bands in the bottom-left corner, a curved arrow turns their output up and right into the visual tokens, which sit beside the instruction tokens under one wide language-model band, with the response tokens above it.
grouping: Each component is a pale, borderless rounded band carrying its name and one math symbol: Vision Encoder (light blue) with Projection W (peach) stacked flush on top in the lower-left, and Language Model f_phi (pale green) spanning almost the full width. Tokens come in rows of three, grouped by fill: visual tokens light grey, instruction tokens mid grey, response tokens green. Labels pair a bold serif math symbol (X_v, Z_v, H_v, H_q, X_q, X_a) with a plain sans word.
shapes_depth: Flat with no shadows and no 3-D. Bands are rounded rectangles with no outline; tokens are small house-shaped pentagons (point up) with thin dark outlines. A thin blue curved line with a grey triangular arrowhead runs from the image label around the left of the vision bands to the visual tokens, labelled Z_v at the bend; a straight up-arrow brings the instruction in. Very thin grey lines fan from every input token to every response token across the language-model band. Most of the canvas is white.
proposed_highlight: No colour or container is reserved for the paper's own part: the one added component, Projection W, is a thin peach band stacked on the vision-encoder band and named by its matrix symbol. The only saturated colour is the green of the response tokens, which draws the eye to the generated output.
lesson: Token glyphs graded by fill (light grey for visual, darker grey for instruction, saturated green for response) separate inputs from generated tokens without a legend.
notes: A very low-ink layout: three fill-only bands, nine small glyphs and math labels carry the whole architecture. Venue as recorded from the arXiv journal-ref; year = arXiv preprint year (2304.08485).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
